nodes.summary: Verify an experiment plan and receipt and apply the experiment gate
usage: corvint-cem-experiments gate --plan FILE --receipt FILE --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX [--repo DIR] [--stable-artifact-root DIR]
nodes.example: corvint-cem-experiments gate --plan FILE --receipt FILE --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX

nodes.summary: Plan a CEM criterion experiment from a request JSON and print its plan digest
usage: corvint-cem-experiments plan --request FILE --out DIR --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX [--repo DIR] [--stable-artifact-root DIR]
nodes.example: corvint-cem-experiments plan --request FILE --out DIR --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX

nodes.summary: Run the approved experiment plan as trusted local test execution and print its receipt digest
usage: corvint-cem-experiments run --plan FILE --approve SHA256 --out DIR --experimental --trusted-local --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX [--repo DIR] [--stable-artifact-root DIR]
nodes.example: corvint-cem-experiments run --plan FILE --approve SHA256 --out DIR --experimental --trusted-local --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX

nodes.summary: Verify an experiment plan and receipt offline
usage: corvint-cem-experiments verify --plan FILE --receipt FILE --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX [--repo DIR] [--stable-artifact-root DIR]
nodes.example: corvint-cem-experiments verify --plan FILE --receipt FILE --tasks-executable PATH --tasks-sha256 HEX
